description: A waveshaper for two signals that runs them twice through a pair of De Jong attractor equations

params.text: Sets the a term of the equations, 0 to 5
Attenuates the voltage at the A jack before it is added to the A knob, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the B jack before it is added to the B knob, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the C jack before it is added to the C knob, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the D jack before it is added to the D knob, 0 to 1
Sets how much of each shaped signal is mixed into the other output, 0 to 1; at 0.5 both outputs carry the same mix and at 0 the two are kept apart

inputs.text: The first signal to be shaped, one per channel
The second signal to be shaped, one per channel; with nothing patched here the first signal is used for both
Modulates the a term, one per volt scaled by the A CV knob
Modulates the b term, one per volt scaled by the B CV knob
Modulates the c term, one per volt scaled by the C CV knob
Modulates the d term, one per volt scaled by the D CV knob

outputs.text: The first shaped signal, with its constant offset removed and the second mixed in by the StW setting
The second shaped signal, with its constant offset removed and the first mixed in by the StW setting

notes: the two signals are fed into each other's equations, so a signal patched into one input alone changes both outputs

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the In1 jack.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.
